Candidate.sql:
WITH t_0_Candidate_MultBodyAggAux AS (SELECT * FROM (
  
    SELECT
      Member.user AS user,
      RoleAccess.resource AS resource
    FROM
      Member, RoleAccess
    WHERE
      (RoleAccess.role = Member.role)
   UNION ALL
  
    SELECT
      Sponsored.user AS user,
      Sponsored.resource AS resource
    FROM
      Sponsored
  
) AS UNUSED_TABLE_NAME  )
SELECT
  Candidate_MultBodyAggAux.user AS user,
  Candidate_MultBodyAggAux.resource AS resource
FROM
  t_0_Candidate_MultBodyAggAux AS Candidate_MultBodyAggAux
GROUP BY Candidate_MultBodyAggAux.user, Candidate_MultBodyAggAux.resource

CanAccess.sql:
SELECT
  Candidate.user AS user,
  Candidate.resource AS resource
FROM
  Candidate
WHERE
  ((SELECT
    MIN((CASE WHEN x_7.unnested_pod = 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END)) AS logica_value
  FROM
    Revoked, (select unnest([0]::numeric[]) as unnested_pod) as x_7
  WHERE
    (Revoked.user = Candidate.user) AND
    (Revoked.resource = Candidate.resource)) IS NULL)
GROUP BY Candidate.user, Candidate.resource
